description:
Create the swap and get the deposit address. No funds move here: the user then sends amount_from of
from_asset to deposit_address (with deposit_extra_id as the memo, when present), as instructions says.
Follow it with get_swap.

RateType.description:
`float`: the market rate when the deposit arrives. `fixed`: what you receive is locked when the swap is
created, usually at a slightly worse rate.

address.description: The user's payout address for to_asset, as they gave it.

amount.description: Amount of from_asset the user sends. Pass this or amount_to.

amount_to.description: Exact amount of to_asset to receive, instead of amount (fixed rate only): the result's amount_from is what the user must send.

email.description: The user's email, when the chosen quote has email_required.

extra_id.description: Memo/tag for the payout address, if the user's wallet needs one (XRP, XLM...).

from_network.description: Network of from_asset, when its ticker is on several.

idempotency_key.description: A UUID made once per swap. A retry with the same one and the same arguments returns the swap already made.

provider.description: The chosen quote's provider. Without it: the best quote now, then the next best, among exchanges without a notice.

rate_type.description: 'float' or 'fixed'. Default float, or fixed with amount_to.

refund_address.description: The user's from_asset address, for a refund if the swap fails.

to_network.description: Network of to_asset, when its ticker is on several.

name: create_swap
title: Create a swap
